Our FinPay backend repo has accumulated serious technical debt across both our Node.js API layer and Python data-processing service. Before our Q3 release freeze next week, the engineering lead needs a single comprehensive document called `dependency_health_report.md` placed in the project root that covers the full health picture of ALL dependency ecosystems in the project.

The report must be actionable enough that any engineer on the team can immediately understand what needs to be fixed urgently, what can wait, and what should simply be removed. It should clearly distinguish between security-critical issues, breaking-change upgrades, minor updates, and dead-weight packages we're no longer using — and it must include the actual commands engineers can run to address each category.

Please analyze the project at /workspace and produce this report.
